Card Q&A.q: Can either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon be specified for the Digimon that are suspended and unsuspended by this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

a: It triggers regardless of which player's Digimon is unsuspended.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger when either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon is unsuspended?

Effect: ＜Vortex＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)
[When Digivolving] Suspend 1 Digimon. Then, unsuspend 1 Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any Digimon unsuspend, for the turn, the effects of your opponent's Digimon don't affect this Digimon and it gets +3000 DP.
